mentions.name: score
mentions.description: This is a full stack Swift web framework with a Controllers pattern for the backend and SwiftUI-like syntax for frontend code. It renders down to minified HTML, CSS, and JS, and includes features for auth, REST, and frontend reactivity via signals.
